## Global Bond Rout Spills Into U.S. Equity Futures; Dow, S&P 500, and Nasdaq Futures Slip

A global bond rout feeding into futures weakness sets a negative macro tone; rate-sensitive and long-duration tech names face incremental headwind, and the PM should assess whether this is a single-session spike or the start of a broader rates repricing.

- A global bond selloff is transmitting risk-off pressure to U.S. equity futures across all three major indexes.
- Coverage flags LUNR, MSTR, WYFI, and AMLX as stocks in focus, though no directional read on each is provided.
- Bond rout implies rate-expectations or duration stress with cross-asset contagion into equities.
- Macro tone is broadly cautionary heading into the open.
